crossRefs.note: Or don’t you know that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.
If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our…
For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will…
For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.
